mapper.select: /* JournalDiaryMapper.getDeletedById */ SELECT diary.id, diary.created_by, diary.journal_chapter_id, diary.idx, day.id AS journalDayId, day.yy AS yy, day.mnth AS mnth FROM journal_diary diary LEFT JOIN journal_chapter chapter ON diary.journal_day_id = chapter.id LEFT JOIN journal_day day ON chapter.journal_day_id = day.id WHERE diary.id = #{id}
/* JournalDiaryMapper.findAllForReorder */ SELECT * FROM journal_diary WHERE journal_chapter_id = #{journalChapterId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY idx
